name: Hilltop Boutique Hotel
address: Drive, 13 Victoria Bay Rd, George, 6530, South Africa
description_short: Boutique hotel dining with ocean views over Victoria Bay's famous surf break and dramatic coastline.
description_long:
Perched above one of the Garden Route's most picturesque bays, Hilltop Boutique Hotel offers dining with sweeping views of the Indian Ocean and the legendary Victoria Bay surf break. The restaurant serves breakfast and dinner to guests and visitors, with a menu that celebrates fresh, locally sourced ingredients and classic preparations.

The intimate dining room opens onto a terrace where you can watch surfers carve up the waves below while enjoying your meal. The kitchen focuses on simple, well-executed dishes that let quality ingredients shine, from line fish caught in local waters to perfectly grilled steaks. It's the kind of place where the view and the food complement each other without competing for attention.

Reservations are recommended, especially for dinner and weekend brunches when locals and visitors alike come for the combination of good food and that unbeatable coastal setting. The relaxed atmosphere makes it equally suited to a romantic dinner or a family meal after a day on the beach.
